text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a spike of tiny GPU pods stuck in PREBIND on ap-southeast1c after the last warm-pool cooldown tweak. ~200 pods Pending, evicting then requeued in loops. Logs show scheduler prebind failures: "node has taint gpu:warm_stale" and binder saying 'no matching slots'.

ops-bot: [Alert] 7498765432 - prebind-failure-rate > 5% in ap-southeast1c :rotating_light:

jon: can you paste the scheduler log lines? looks like taint propagation + latebind

maya: paste below
```
I0302 12:21:03 scheduler.go:1234] prebind failed for pod gpu-train-xyz: no nodes with available slots matching request
I0302 12:21:04 taint-controller.go:88] set taint gpu:warm_stale on node n-az3-07
I0302 12:21:06 scheduler.go:1250] retrying prebind for pod gpu-train-xyz
```

sreenath: my suspicion: cooldown was shortened and warm-pool nodes are getting tainted before orphaned KV cache cleared — scheduler treats the taint as hard exclusion so prebind skips nodes, which breaks gang scheduling/packing. small pods end up bouncing.

eva: can we confirm warm-pool reclaim vs node taint timing? a telemetry chart (node_taint_set -> pod_requeue delta) would help.

patrick: trying a quick mitigation: bump cooldown on warm-pool controller to 10m and restart controller in ap-southeast1c canary. commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/warmpool-controller --image=registry/redwood/warmpool:canary-20260321
kubectl patch warmpool default -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/cooldownSeconds","value":600}]'
```

maya: applied canary to az3 (2 pods). monitoring metrics — initial requeue rate down ~60% in 3m. :thumbsup:

jon: long term: scheduler prebind should allow nodes with gpu:warm_stale taint when pod annotation allow_warm_stale=true (and then prefer non-stale nodes). fallback to gang preemption ordering if pack fails. @sreenath can you own a ticket?

sreenath: filing RFC/ticket now — will include perf tests and a tiny k8s scheduler plugin to gate prebind decision. also proposing a new metric prebind_skip_taint for Console alerts.

maya: created incident doc and added runbook steps (start canary, monitor requeues, rollback cooldown). plan: roll cooldown bump to whole region tonight in low-traffic window, implement scheduler fix next sprint.

patrick: quick cost note — longer cooldown increases reserved GPU-hours ~3% for ap-southeast1c. finance ok with temporary bump? @maya

maya: flagged finance; we can revert if cost delta >5%. keeping watch, will post updates in the incident thread.
